data.name: Incident Report
data.description: Official UKVI & Clearsprings compliant incident report form with full factual disclosure, authority notifications, and evidence tracking (Super Admin Verified).

fieldDefinitions.name: witnesses
fieldDefinitions.label: Witnesses (SUs) (Name/Port)
fieldDefinitions.placeholder: e.g. Welfare officer (Emeka Opara) or N/A

fieldDefinitions.name: incidentDescription
fieldDefinitions.label: Incident Description
fieldDefinitions.placeholder: Please complete with as much detail as possible, stating only facts...

fieldDefinitions.name: actionTaken
fieldDefinitions.label: Action Taken
fieldDefinitions.placeholder: Describe exact action and steps taken...

headerConfig.subtitle: Please complete with as much detail as possible, stating only facts. Please email CST@Clearsprings.co.uk who will review and send it to UKVI where appropriate.

footerConfig.customText: Please attach photos of any evidence where possible when submitting to CST.
